newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian held with fortune in suspect Japan bonds.
newsitem.headline: Italian held with fortune in suspect Japan bonds.

text.p: An Italian man carrying a huge fortune in suspect Japanese bank bonds was arrested after arriving at Venice's Marco Polo airport on a flight from Tokyo, a customs official said on Tuesday.
The 45-year-old, who was not named, was stopped on Monday after police at the airport found a batch of newly printed certificates in his leather briefcase.

Italian news agencies said the certificates had a face value of 900 billion yen ($7.4 billion) but added that police believed they were forgeries. The customs official said a "large amount" of money was involved, but declined to give details.
The arrested man was believed to be a freelance journalist who was working in Japan.
